audit.why: Aurora owns level 1 on range (Twofold Hex 900 vs Five Point Strike 550); Akali takes over from 4-5 once Twilight Shroud can break the curse line, through 6 and first item; it drifts back to skill at two items when Aurora's range and Between Worlds zone control matter more than a single burst. 54.25% owner win rate over 182 games supports the Akali-sided middle.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Level 6 phase text were the generic template — no ability, no number.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is 9s at rank 1 and 900 range, which is the real level-1 problem. At 6 the deciding spike is Between Worlds (140s at rank 1): Riot's text says it releases a slowing shockwave and then leaves a zone that keeps slowing enemies inside it, so the slow, not her damage, is what strands you after Perfect Execution's re-dash.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds is 140s and its zone slows everyone inside — burst her before the slow lands, or your R re-dash is wasted.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks a non-existent ability called "Twofold Hunt (Blink)" and describes it as her escape. Aurora has no ability by that name. The packet also flags that this matchup never names a single one of her real abilities.
audit.why: Her blink escape is Across the Veil (W): 22/21/20/19/18, a leap that leaves her invisible with bonus move speed. "Twofold Hex" is her Q (9/8.5/8/7.5/7, 900 range): the missile curses enemies it hits and the recast drags active curses back toward her for a second damage instance — so leaving the line after the first hit is the counterplay, and that interaction was never stated. The Weirding (E, 15s at rank 1) slows and then hops her backward, which is what breaks your Shuriken Flip follow-up.
audit.corrected: Twofold Hex (9s) curses you on hit — the recast drags the curse back for a second hit, so break line early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup mentions anti-heal, and the Don't about poking from range explained nothing.
audit.why: _missing/akali.json flags Aurora as sustaining through chip damage via Spirit Abjuration (P) — her spells and attacks exorcise spirits that follow her and heal her. Chip poke feeds that; Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trade.
audit.corrected: Poke through her spirits — Spirit Abjuration heals her, so Oblivion Orb comes first.
